license_note: The official model card states Apache 2.0 as the license for the Devstral-Small-2507 repository and checkpoints, both in its metadata and in prose. The repository carries no separate license file, so the pinned model card is the governing artifact; no use restrictions are attached.

license_evidence.scope: Official Devstral-Small-2507 model repository, consolidated and sharded Safetensors checkpoints, tokenizer, and parameters

access_boundary: This record represents the mistralai/Devstral-Small-2507 release (Devstral Small 1.1, July 2025). The earlier Devstral-Small-2505, Devstral Medium, the Mistral Small 3.1 base, the deprecated devstral-small-2507 API model, and downstream quantizations and fine-tunes remain separate boundaries.
strengths: Mistral AI publishes ungated consolidated and Transformers-style Safetensors checkpoints, the tokenizer, the system prompt, and a first-party GGUF repository
The model card documents vLLM, mistral-inference, Transformers, LM Studio, llama.cpp, and Ollama paths with pinned library versions and local agent-scaffold setup
tradeoffs: The license is carried in model-card metadata and prose rather than a repository license file
The first-party API model named on the card is deprecated with a published retirement date, so served access now depends on self-operation or independent hosts

evidence.label: Official model card, checkpoints, and deployment guidance
Official Mistral AI model page with version, release, and deprecation dates
